items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Sandra Gordon, a fellow met my son and told him, I don't know Walter. I said, you don't? No, so a fellow buddy told him, a guitar player, he said, well that's Albert Fernandez's son. I said, oh, I used to play jitney dance years ago with your dad.

ctx.x: Albert Vincent Paul Walters, known as musician Fernandez. How did you get that name? Why did they call you that?

Well, my stepfather raised me and that name just followed Fernandez. And practically all the older musicians know me by the name of Fernandez. I mean my son, Albert's son is a trumpet player and he introduced himself and nobody knows, he's older people, so you've got to explain the name of Fernandez. Then they recognized him, well yeah, I know your father good. And then, Sandra Gordon, a fellow met my son and told him, I don't know Walter. I said, you don't? No, so a fellow buddy told him, a guitar player, he…
Well you've got some other nicknames too, Badda, huh?
